_comment: Real diffs from popular open-source repos, pinned by full SHA so a fixture is reproducible. `expect` mirrors the GitHub API stats for that commit at pinning time — prepare.mjs cross-checks our own manifest against it, so a fixture doubles as a manifest correctness test. Fetched with --depth 2, so the diff to analyze is always HEAD~1..HEAD.

quick.title: feat: allow conditional revalidation for QUERY requests
quick.why: Smallest useful end-to-end run: 3 files, one behavior change plus its test. Use it to check that the pipeline works at all after a change.

feature.title: feat(middleware): add method-not-allowed middleware
feature.why: A new module with its tests and package registration — exercises cause groups, the story chain and the tests tab on a clean, small diff.

migration.title: streams: Add default_push_notifications field to Stream
migration.why: A schema change with a Django migration plus the model, API types and docs that follow from it — the fixture for er-diff, ops/migrations and cross-layer edges. Still small enough to iterate on.

big.title: Add requested_deletion_at attribute to Account for deleted-but-not-suspended accounts
big.why: 63 files: a Rails migration + schema dump + a repeated guard across dozens of controllers. The stress test — classifier sharding, verify-pattern groups, plumbing, blast radius, er-diff. Slow; run it before a release, not on every edit.

synthetic.title: acme-shop: refunds recorded as rows, order status renamed to state (generated locally)
synthetic.why: No network, ~1s to build, 10 files across TS/PHP/SQL/MD with a schema migration that adds a table AND renames a column — the deterministic way to exercise scope tags, language dots, er-diff and ops/migrations.
